verdicts.reason: A rewraps the headline onto one line for the banner, keeps its weight, and centres it vertically. The only flaw is that the side margins are a little tight for the minimal, quiet feel of the original. B keeps the portrait two-line break, so the headline is small and swamped by empty space on both sides. It also sits low in the frame, with roughly 60px above and 35px below, so it reads as a shrunk copy rather than a layout made for the banner.
